decision_rules: Authority is the durable source that may mint or change canonical state.
Transport carries canonical references and untrusted payloads but cannot mint authority.
Projection renders or summarizes authority and cannot promote maturity or health.
Configured identity is not current observation; current observation is not operator authorization.
Execution evidence is not approved knowledge; model or council agreement is not approval.
